issues.display_title: Issue #3005: Support High-Resolution (16K) Uploads with Automatic Client-Side Downscaling to 8K on Live & Dev
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Enable the Panorra Mobile app to accept ultra-high-resolution panoramas (such as 15,520 x 7,760 px from the Insta360 X6) and automatically downscale them to 8K (8,192 x 4,096 px) before uploading. Currently, images exceeding 15,000 pixels are rejected during the upload selection step.
